quarterly_data.signal: Marine service order (release): Wärtsilä signed a Lifecycle Agreement with charity Mercy Ships International covering a 5-year renewal of the existing service agreement for the hospital ship Global Mercy (powered by four Wärtsilä 32 engines of 3,360 kW each) and a 3-year service agreement for the newbuild Africa Mercy II (scheduled for delivery in 2028); scope includes spare parts, field services, crew training and the Expert Insight predictive maintenance service; booked in Q3 2026.
